# Why faith & spiritual organizations keeps re-telling the story of Ọbàtálá
Every age hires the same gods; only the job titles change. **Ọbàtálá** never stopped working.

Ọbatalá's mythology turns on creation, sobriety, and the cost of pride. He is the elder who knows that making life is more difficult than destroying it.

The [pattern atlas](/patterns/) — which maps every flagship temple to the industries its archetype demonstrably resonates with, each match argued and open to challenge — seats this temple in **3 industries**. This file reads those seats the way they were earned: through the myths.
## At a Glance

- **Temple:** Ọbàtálá
- **Pantheon:** Yoruba
- **Domain of influence:** Creation, Purity, Peace
- **Pattern seats:** 3
- **Sectors touched:** Society & Spirit · Technology & Innovation · Health & Wellbeing
- **Strongest seat:** Faith & Spiritual Organizations
- **Series:** The Resonance Files, No. 170 of 271
## The Myth at Work

**The Moulding of Humanity.** When Olódùmarè decided to populate the earth, he sent Ọbatalá down with a lump of clay.  Ọbatalá shaped the first human bodies with care, but one day he drank too much palm wine and some of his figures came out twisted or incomplete. — remember the shape of that act. You will see it again, wearing a logo.

**The Elder of the Orishas.** In many Ifá verses, Ọbatalá is the eldest orixá, the one who remembers the beginning of things.  He does not compete for followers with the flashier gods of thunder and rivers; his authority rests on age, clarity, and the fact that every human body was once clay in his hands. — hold that image; the industries below are where it goes to work.
## The Seats

Each of these is argued in the atlas with a weight and a why-line. What the atlas cannot fit in one line is the whole myth — so here is each seat with its story restored.

### Faith & Spiritual Organizations

*Religious institutions, faith media, and devotional services. (Sector: Society & Spirit)*

*The king of white cloth; purity worshipped in living Orisha tradition.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

### Manufacturing, Craft & Automation

*Fabrication, industrial craft, and robotics. (Sector: Technology & Innovation)*

*The divine potter who moulded the first human bodies from clay; shaping matter into living form is the industry's founding act.* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function Ọbàtálá performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

### Mental Health & Emotional Wellness

*Therapy, emotional wellbeing, and mindfulness. (Sector: Health & Wellbeing)*

*Ìtẹ̀lọ́rùn — patience, coolness of heart — is his temperament and his teaching; emotional regulation is his oldest discipline.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

Read the myth again after the seats and it stops sounding ancient: Ọbatalá's mythology turns on creation, sobriety, and the cost of pride. The age changed. The work did not.

If you work in faith & spiritual organizations, manufacturing, craft & automation, or any trade this temple holds a seat in, this is the honest version of what a placement means: your industry beside the story it has been re-telling all along — on the temple floor itself, before an audience that came specifically to read it. The [patron tier](/sites/obatala/patron/) and the [advertising terms](/terms/advertising/) describe the mechanics; the resonance above describes the fit.
